findings.summary: Peer cwd manifests are checked only for two-read stability, not reconciled with the paused baseline/current approval boundary; stable out-of-scope changes can resume.
A legitimate running child whose cwd is a descendant of the approved worktree is rejected because exact root equality is required.
Git worktree changed-file observation reads every changed file wholly with no count or byte bound.

graphify_stamp_drift: review-required graphify query updated graphify-out/cache/last_query_stamp only
